strand_a.summary: Choose Europe : Research Careers, Brain Drain and Policy Lessons from the CESAER 2024 Survey. We propose three strategic priorities to reverse Europe’s brain drain and achieve balanced brain circulation by 2035: (1) establishing an effective European Research Careers Observatory to monitor job quality and mobility; (2) reforming research assessment to emphasize stability and inclusivity; and (3) expanding EU–national co-funding mechanisms to create sustainable career pathways.
